system.name: MPC
system.one_liner: Multi-behavior recommender with several purchase chains that pass embeddings between behaviours and a negative graph that removes negative transfer.

content.variant_note: boxed pipeline of blue-outlined modules joined by green block arrows, with one behavior-transfer module enlarged below by a dashed cone
content.argues: Several purchase chains of different lengths each pass embeddings from one behaviour to the next, and a negative graph filters what should not transfer.
content.subject: Interaction graphs, GCN initialisation, chained behavior-transfer modules with a zoomed negative-graph branch, aggregation and a joint loss.

lessons.what_to_learn: Keep one colour per behaviour on every glyph that belongs to it (graph edges, embedding tiles, loss terms), so the reader can follow a behaviour through a dense multi-module figure, and enlarge the one new module with a dashed cone.
lessons.suits: graph or sequence models with several behaviours, views or modalities that pass embeddings through many small modules.

evidence: MPC consists of three key components: initialization, behavior transfer and negative transfer elimination.
We construct multiple purchase chains to explicitly model the dependencies between multiple behaviors.
We construct negative graphs for latter behavior on purchase chains to get the negative representations

summary: MPC is a multi-behavior recommender that builds several purchase chains (for example view to purchase, or view to cart to purchase) and removes negative transfer with negative graphs. The figure is a boxed pipeline of blue-outlined modules joined by thick green block arrows. At the top, four interaction graphs (V, H, K, P) feed a hollow arrow labelled Negative Graphs Construction, with a small example in which the H and K graphs lead to the K/H graph. Below, the Initialization Module runs a GCN per behaviour into coloured embedding tiles; the Multiple Purchase Chain box stacks rows PC1 to PCn of BT Module boxes; a dashed cone enlarges one BT Module into K GCN and K/H GCN branches; then come Aggregate and the Joint Learning Module with loss terms. One colour per behaviour runs through graphs, tiles and losses.
summary_zh: MPC 的框架图：顶部四种行为的交互图经“负图构建”得到示例负图；下方依次是初始化模块、由 BT 模块串成的多条购买链、聚合与联合学习模块，虚线锥形把 BT 模块放大成正负两路 GCN；行为用统一颜色贯穿图、嵌入块和损失项。
notes: Prior kinds kept (model-anatomy, stage-pipeline). The framed rounded boxes are module containers of one drawing, not panels, so panel_count is 1 although the index counts 6. The operator inside the BT Module is drawn as a circle with a cross and is read as joining the positive and negative parts. The yellow and green nodes are read as users and items. The digest reports no dashed shapes, but the zoom cone is dashed in print (dash segments).
